This is original audio for a cozy dark-fantasy comedy, 2D quarter-view castle-defense game. It must be new material, not an imitation of any artist, franchise, existing song, or copyrighted melody.

Compose an original instrumental game soundtrack lasting about 120 seconds. 108 BPM, F Lydian. Tiny medals awarded to endearing monster defenders. Muted cornet, oboe, music box and light bass; luminous Lydian lift and playful restrained ceremonial answers, readable beneath reward sounds, no bombastic triumph or hard closing cadence. Develop a complete original 120-second instrumental arc, with compatible opening and final two seconds for a seamless loop. Keep the arrangement readable under frequent combat sound effects. No vocals, spoken words, choir syllables, or recognizable samples. Build a coherent arc without a hard ending. Keep the opening and final two seconds texturally compatible so they can be crossfaded into a seamless loop.
